# Bisendra Melaram

> Bisendra Melaram, Team Leader of Keller Williams Greater Nassau in Garden City, NY, and a seller's agent on Long Island's South Shore. Licensed Real Estate Salesperson since 2003. He mainly lists and sells homes, and also represents buyers, across Long Island, with a focus on the South Shore of Nassau County (Valley Stream, Lynbrook, Rockville Centre, Oceanside, Baldwin, Freeport).

Office: Keller Williams Greater Nassau, 400 Garden City Plaza, Suite 438, Garden City, NY 11530. Phone 516-873-7100.

## Seller guides (one question per page, with sources)
- [Pricing a home in Nassau County](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/pricing/): How to set a list price for a Nassau County home from closed sales, with 2026 OneKey MLS county data, by seller's agent Bisendra Melaram, PSA.
- [What it costs to sell](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/cost-to-sell/): Seller costs on Long Island: negotiable commission, New York transfer tax at $2 per $500, attorney fees, payoffs, concessions and taxes on the gain.
- [Best time to list](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/best-time-to-sell/): When to list a Nassau County home, from 2025 and 2026 OneKey MLS monthly data: days on market, percent of list price received and new listings.
- [New York property condition disclosure](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/property-condition-disclosure/): What New York home sellers must disclose under Real Property Law 462: who files, when, the flood questions since 2024, and how to prepare.
- [Selling an inherited home](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/inherited-home/): How to sell an inherited home in Nassau County: Surrogate's Court, probate and administration, who signs, taxes on inherited property, and the house itself.
- [Short sales and pre-foreclosure](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/short-sale-pre-foreclosure/): Behind on a Long Island mortgage? New York's 90-day notice, free counseling, short sales and other options, from SFR-certified agent Bisendra Melaram.
- [Selling for military orders](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/military-relocation/): Selling or renting your Long Island home when military orders move you: the IRS five-year suspension, SCRA protections and selling from a distance.
- [Selling a second home or beach property](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/second-home/): Selling a Long Island second home or waterfront property: taxes when it is not your main home, nonresident estimated tax, and flood disclosure.
- [Choosing a listing agent](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/choosing-a-listing-agent/): How to choose a Long Island listing agent: verify the New York license, ask how they price from closed sales, read the listing agreement, negotiate the fee.
- [Property taxes, grievances and your sale](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/property-taxes/): How Nassau County property taxes affect a sale: assessments at 0.1 percent, Town of Hempstead due dates, grieving with ARC, and STAR for the buyer.
